title: a16z Podcast: On Government as Software Builder, Not Just Buyer

reader_summary.overview: We already know that the government is one of the largest IT buyers, but in many ways it is also an IT builder. Especially for areas where the government is doing something that no one else is doing, like running Medicare and Social Security -- i.e..
